about: Enemy playbook for the Isaac bot: a baseline of how each enemy behaves, so the bot starts with known behaviour instead of learning it by getting hit. See ENEMIES.md.
sources: floor lists: bindingofisaacrebirth.wiki.gg floor pages (Basement, Cellar, Burning Basement, Downpour, Dross; Caves, Catacombs, Flooded Caves, Mines, Ashpit partly)
behaviour: Isaac knowledge; anything not certain is in 'unsure'
bot_hits_logged: runs/hits.jsonl as of 2026-11-25 (tests + real play)
source 'hand': the hand table; 'reviewed': local-AI draft corrected by hand (floors 1-4); 'draft': local-AI tags from the wiki text, not hand-checked (treat as unsure)
game numbers and animation event frames: NOT in this file (game-derived); local knowledge/playbook_game.json, same keys
wiki: bindingofisaacrebirth.wiki.gg page the draft was made from (tools/wiki_bestiary.py)
key_format: type.variant, same as hits.jsonl causes (e.g. '23.0'). Variants not listed: fall back to type.0 and treat as unsure.

movement.stationary: never moves (may still turn or shoot)
movement.wanders: drifts or walks at random, not toward Isaac
movement.chases: walks or floats straight toward Isaac
movement.hops: moves in short hops (airborne mid-hop, lands on a spot)
movement.jumps: long leaps that land at or near Isaac's spot
movement.bursts: sudden fast bursts in a random direction (spiders): position a moment later is a circle, not a line
movement.dashes_at_isaac: sudden fast dash toward Isaac's current spot
movement.charges_on_line: dashes in a straight line when Isaac lines up on its row or column
movement.burrows: goes underground (untouchable), surfaces near or under Isaac
movement.orbits: circles something (its parent, a boss, a point)
movement.tethered: on a cord or tied to a parent; can't go further than the cord allows
movement.bounces: flies diagonally and bounces off walls
movement.slides_on_line: slides fast along a row or column when Isaac lines up (Slide/Poky style)

attacks.shoots_single: fires one shot aimed at Isaac
attacks.shoots_spread: fires a fan of shots toward Isaac
attacks.shoots_ring: fires shots in fixed directions (plus, X or full ring), not aimed
attacks.shoots_burst: fires a cluster or volley of many shots at once (shotgun / random burst)
attacks.lobbed: arcing shots that land on a spot (shadow on the floor shows where)
attacks.stomp: lands on a spot from above (shadow shows where)
attacks.fire: is or leaves fire that hurts on touch
attacks.slam: melee wave/shockwave or ground slam around itself

defense.invulnerable_until: can't be hurt until something happens (opens, surfaces, lands)
defense.invulnerable: can never be killed by tears; avoid or ignore
defense.splits: turns into smaller enemies on death
defense.reforms: comes back after 'death' unless hit again (Globin puddle)
defense.shielded_front: blocks tears from the front; hit from behind/side
defense.phases: boss changes attacks at low health
defense.linked: shares health or behaviour with another part (twins, segments)
defense.speeds_up_when_hurt: gets faster as it loses health

scales.danger: 1 = harmless unless touched ... 5 = top threat for a no-hit bot
scales.kill_priority: 3 = kill first (spawners, homers, shooters, line-chargers), 2 = normal, 1 = whenever, 0 = can't or shouldn't (invulnerable, hazards)

non_enemy_hit_causes.0.8: spikes (floor hazard) - check against Isaac's edge, not centre
non_enemy_hit_causes.0.14: unsure: non-entity damage (curse room door / sacrifice spikes?)
non_enemy_hit_causes.0.0: no source: explosion (TNT, bomb), crushed etc.
non_enemy_hit_causes.2.0: Isaac's own tear (exploding tears like Fire Mind / Ipecac)

10.0.name: Gaper

10.1.name: Frowning Gaper

11.1.name: Pacer

214.0.name: Level 2 Fly

886.0.how: Kill the Demon first to trigger the laser, then kite the flying Fatty while avoiding its diagonal Brimstone beams.

886.1.name: Fetal Demon
886.1.how: Stay away from the Vis Fatty and the Fetal Demon; it lunges when close and chases you if untethered.

887.0.name: Dusty Death's Head
887.0.how: Ignore it as it is invulnerable; it only deals damage if you touch it.

888.0.name: Shady
888.0.how: Stay away from walls to avoid ring explosions; dodge its cardinal jump explosions and shoot from a distance.

890.0.name: Maze Roamer
890.0.how: Stay out of its line of sight. Kill both simultaneously to prevent the survivor from chasing you.

891.0.name: Goat
891.0.how: Avoid its row and column to prevent charges; stay at a distance to avoid contact and spread shots.

891.1.name: Black Goat
891.1.how: Avoid its row and column to prevent charges; stay clear of cardinal directions for lasers; shoot from a distance.

892.0.name: Poofer
892.0.how: Keep distance to avoid the radial shots and death creep; it takes 40 damage before it starts dying.

893.0.name: Ball and Chain
893.0.how: Avoid the ball's path as it is indestructible. Do not target it; focus on other enemies.

903.0.name: The Visage
903.0.how: Break chain first. Avoid cardinal lines. Hide behind mask during fire rings. Destroy plasma balls. Stay away from heart's chain.

903.20.name: Visage Plasma
903.20.how: Avoid its path as it bounces off walls diagonally; shoot it to prevent it from reviving the mask.

904.0.name: The Siren
904.0.how: Avoid the black creep. Stay back during the scream shockwave. Kill minions quickly to prevent the cluster attack.

905.0.name: The Heretic
905.0.how: Avoid lobbed fire spots. Dodge the dash-charge and stay away from lit fire places to avoid the laser.

909.0.name: The Scourge
909.0.how: Stay away from walls to avoid creep/maggots. Shoot tendrils to break its attacks. Watch for the triangle trap and move through gaps.

910.0.name: Chimera
910.0.how: Avoid its creep trails and jumps. Stay off its vertical line to avoid the laser. Kill the head first to stop the bounces.

911.0.name: Rotgut
911.0.how: Stay centered. Avoid the platform in phase 2 to avoid the laser and gas. Dodge the bouncing blood projectiles in phase 3.

912.0.name: Mother
912.0.how: Phase 1: stay away from hands. Phase 2: dodge the laser, move opposite to the splitting ball, and watch for wall lines.

912.20.name: Dead Isaac
912.20.how: Avoid touching them as they walk upward. They are mostly a hazard when Mother launches their corpses at you.

915.1.name: Singe's Ball
915.1.how: Avoid touching the ball; it is pushed by tears and explosions. It is not a primary threat.

916.0.name: Bumbino
916.0.how: Stay off its row/column when it charges. Dodge swipes and ground slams; shoot from a distance.
916.0.unsure: local-AI draft, not hand-checked; boss; tags unchecked

920.0.name: The Horny Boys
920.0.how: Maintain distance. Dodge the thrown bombs and the fireballs. Watch for the Brimstone bombs and the massive tear patterns.

921.0.name: Clutch
921.0.how: Kill the Clacks first. Avoid cardinal lines when a Clack is possessed. In phase 2, dodge its rush and flame volleys.
921.0.unsure: local-AI draft, not hand-checked; boss; tags unchecked

950.0.name: Dogma
950.0.how: Phase 1: Attack TV, avoid radial bursts and cardinal star. Phase 2: Dodge feathers, avoid spinning beams, and dash away from the wheel charge.

951.0.name: The Beast
951.0.how: Stay in the gap during fire rings. Dodge the Brimstone beam. Avoid the orange lines and the chasing Beast Souls.

951.10.name: Ultra Famine
951.10.how: Stay off its row during charges. Dodge flies and stay centered during phase 2's circular and burst patterns.

951.11.name: Ultra Famine Fly
951.11.how: Sidestep the charge and watch for the volley of shots from the ground. Shoot it quickly.
951.11.unsure: local-AI draft, not hand-checked; The specific animation for the ground-based volley is not listed.

951.20.name: Ultra Pestilence
951.20.how: Avoid the maggot's path and the Ipecac pillars. Kill the flies and the fly ball to reduce pressure.

951.21.name: Ultra Pestilence Fly
951.21.how: Stay away from the swarm; they block shots and deal contact damage. Shoot from a distance.
951.21.unsure: local-AI draft, not hand-checked; The specific animation for the 'pop out of ground' variant is not listed.

951.23.name: Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball
951.23.how: Stay away and shoot from a distance; it spawns flies when hit and one on death.

951.30.name: Ultra War
951.30.how: Avoid the cross-pattern bombs and lava pillars. Stay mobile during its lunges and fire during its fire-stream phase.

951.40.name: Ultra Death
951.40.how: Avoid the scythe rectangle and heads. Stay away from his red eye during the dark phase and dodge the scythe swing.

951.41.name: Ultra Death Scythe
951.41.how: Stay off its row or column when it moves; it only deals contact damage.

951.42.name: Ultra Death Head
951.42.how: Ignore it as it is invulnerable; it only deals damage if you touch it.

966.0.name: Siren Helper
966.0.how: It behaves like a standard familiar; maintain distance and shoot it down while it flies toward you.
966.0.unsure: local-AI draft, not hand-checked; The specific familiar it takes the form of varies, but it follows the behavior of the charmed familiar it currently controls.
